spans.s:
Secede,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓapasf 1 P, apagam 1 P, apa-yA-i 2 P, apakram 1 U, 4 P; vyapasf &c.; (to) ASri 1 U, ava-A-laMb 1 A; (from) (DarmaM &c.) tyaj 1 P, utsfj 6 P; matAMtaraM grah 9 U or ASri &c.
Ⓝ[Seced]er,Ⓒs.ⒹBinnamatASritaH; matAMtaragrAhin m.
ⓃSecession,Ⓒs.ⒹapasaraRaM, apagamaH-manaM, apakramaH-maRaM, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 matAMtara-svIkAraH-grahaRaM, svaDarmatyAgaH.

Seclude,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓni-ava-ruD 7 U, gup 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 vivikte vas c., pfTak kf 8 U; vi-vic 3, 7 U or c.
Ⓑ
 3 (Oneself) viviktaM ASri 1 U or sev 1 A, vivikte-ekAMte-vas 1 P, janasaMsargaM tyaj 1 P or parihf 1 P or vfj 10.
Ⓝ[Seclud]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓvivikta, nirjana, vijana, niBfta; See Lonely.
Ⓑ
 2 (Of persons) tyakta-mukta-saMga, viviktasevin-vAsin-vftti.
ⓃSeclusion,Ⓒs.Ⓓrahas n., viviktatA, ekAMtatA, viviktadaSA-sTiti f.; rahaHsTAnaM, viviktaM, ekAMtavAsaH.

Second,Ⓒa.ⒹdvitIya; ‘s(econd) to none’, ‘without a s(econd)’ advitIya, anuttara, atyuttama; ‘s(econd) in rank’ dvitIyapadaBAk.
Ⓑ
 2 Secondary, q. v.; ‘s(econd)-hand’ BuktapUrva, anyaBukta-vyavahArita, anyopayukta; anyakalpita, anyasfzwa; ‘s(econd)-hand information’ anyasmAdaDigatA vArtA; ‘s(econd)-hand witness’ SrutasAkzin m. ‘s(econd) rate’ maDyama, sAmAnya; ‘s(econd)-sight’ divyacakzus n. -dfzwi f.
Ⓔs.ⒹvipalaM; vikalA; kzaRaH nimi-(me) zaH.
Ⓑ
 2 sahAyaH, sahakArin m., upakArI.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓanumud 1 A, anugrah 9 P, upakf 8 U, aBinaMd 1 P.
Ⓝ[Second]er,Ⓒs.Ⓓanumodin m., samarTa-yitf m., pakzodgrAhI.
Ⓝ[Second]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹdvitIyataH, dvitIyasTAne.
ⓃSecondary,Ⓒa.ⒹapraDAna, gORa (RI f.), amuKya, anuzaMgin, upasarjana, upasfzwa, apraTama; oft. by upa pr.; ‘a s(econdary) planet’ upagrahaH; ‘a s(econdary) rank’ aprADAnyaM.
Ⓑ
 2 maDyama, sAmAnya, sAmAnyaguRaka.
Ⓝ[Secondari]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹaprADAnyena, gORataH, apraDAnataH, anuzaMgataH.

Secret,Ⓒa.Ⓓni-, gUQa, gupta, pra-, Canna, niBfta, saMvfta, avyakta, aprakASa, avidita; ‘s(ecret) door’ pracCannaM, aMtardvAraM.
Ⓑ
 2 guhya, gopya, rahasya, saM-varaRIya.
Ⓑ
 3 guhyABedin, rahasyABedin.
Ⓑ
 4 gahana, gUQa, avyakta, gUQArTa, gahanArTa.
Ⓑ
 5 rahas in comp., vivikta, nirjana, niBfta; ‘keep s(ecret)’ guh, 1 U, Cad 10; See Conceal.
Ⓔs.ⒹrahasyaM; guhyaM, gopyaM, marman n.; ‘have you kept the s(ecret) entrusted to you’ rakzyate BavatA rahasyanikzepaH (
); ‘the s(econdary) of oneʼs power’ SakteH rahasyaM; ‘the s(econdary) of good men (of their conduct)’ sADUnAM rahasyaM (

); ‘in s(ecret)’ rahasi, rahaH, miTaH; ‘s(ecret) counsel’ maMtraH, gUQamaMtraH; ‘knowing s(ecret)s’ rahasyajYa, aMtarvedin; marmavid; ‘the matter is no longer a s(ecret)’ bahulIBUtaH-prakASatAM gataH-so'rTaH; ‘diving into the s(ecret)s of others’ paramarmaBedin, marmAnvezin, pararahasyavid.
Ⓝ[Secret]ly,Ⓒadv.Ⓓpra-, CannaM, gUQaM, ni-BftaM, guptaM, avyaktaM, upAMSu, gUQa-gupta in comp.; ‘walking s(ecretly)’ gUQAcAra, guptasaMcArin.
Ⓝ[Secret]ness, Secrecy,Ⓒs.ⒹguptatA, gUQatA, pracCa-nnatA, gupti f., gupta-niBfta-BAvaH.
Ⓑ
 2 saMvftti f., guptiH, guhya-rahasya-rakzaRaM, gopanaM, rahasyA-BedaH-pAlanaM, mOnaM, aprakASanaM.
Ⓑ
 3 viviktatA; rahaH, rahovAsaH, viviktavAsaH, -BAvaH.

Secrete,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓsru c., pra-niH-pari-°, nirgam c., niHsf c., udvam 1 P, ud-gF 6 P, utsfj 6 P; (bile, &c.) ut-, ric 7 P or c.; utpad c., jan c.; ‘the mouth frequently s(ecrete)s saliva’ muhurvaktraM lAlAyate, lAlAM srA-vayati.
Ⓑ
 2 gup 1 P, guh 1 U, saMvf 5 U, apa-ni-hnu 2 A; See Conceal.
Ⓝ[Secret]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹsrAvaH-vaRaM, udrecanaM, utsargaH, utpAdanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 malaM; ‘s(ecretion) of the throat’ kaPaH, Slezman m. ‘s(ecretion) of the bowels’ purIzaM, vizWA; See Dung.

Sect,Ⓒs.ⒹSAKA, paTin m., mAgaH, pakzaH, mataM, saMpradAyaH, gaRaH.
Ⓝ[Sect]ary, [Sect]ariar,Ⓒa.ⒹSAKAgata, sAMpradAyika (kI f.); svapakzAnusArin, SA-KAvalaMbin, SAKASrita.
Section,Ⓒs.Ⓓvi-, BAgaH, CedaH, paricCedaH; KaMqaH, -qaM, parvan n., prakaraRaM, ullAsaH, ucCvAsaH, skaMDaH, kAMqaH-qaM, pAdaH (of different compositions); ‘sub-s(ection)’ aDikaraRaM.

Secure,Ⓒa.Ⓓsurakzita, akutoBaya, aBaya, nirBaya, vItaBaya, anASya, nirAbADa, nirviGna; (of persons); niHSaMka, aSaMka, niSciMta, nirAtaka, nirapekza, svasTa.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓrakz 1 P, BayaM nivf c., or nivft c. or niras 4 U, nirBayIkf 8 U; ex. by (a.) with kf.
Ⓑ
 2 sTirIkf, dfQIkf, nirRI 1 P.
Ⓑ
 3 dfQaM baMD 9 P; ‘s(ecur)ed with a bolt’ argalAbadDaM (dvAraM).
Ⓑ
 4 Akram 1 U, 4 P, grah 9 U.
Ⓝ[Secur]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹrakzA-kzaRaM, gupti f., sTEryaM, pari-, trARaM, gopanaM, kzemaH-maM, nirBayatvaM, ahAryatA, SaMkABAvaH, aBayaM.
Ⓑ
 2 aBayavAc f., aBayadAnaM-dakziRA.
Ⓑ
 3 ra-kzakaH, SaraRaM, ASrayaH.
Ⓑ
 4 pratiBUH, baMDakaH, lagnakaH (persons); prAtiBAvyaM, ADiH, nyAsaH, nikzepaH; See Pledge.
Ⓝ[Secure]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹniHSaMkaM, nirBayaM, kzemeRa, nirAbADaM.
